**It looks like the old history was replaced.** The [GitHub repository](https://api.github.com/repos/tteggel/.dotfiles) was created on **6 June 2012**, so the repository itself predates this NixOS setup.

What survives now:

- History starts with the fresh “Minimal WSL config” root commit dated **10 November 2025**.
- None of the **238 remote refs** or local unreachable commits preserve earlier history.
- GitHub lists no forks, and I found no other checkout in the local development directories I checked.

That’s consistent with pushing a newly initialized repo over the old `master`, likely using a force-push. I can’t establish exactly what happened or when.

An **older machine or backup containing a clone** is the best recovery lead.
